title: Send click events in vue 3 - TypeError: window.aa is not a function
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I am trying to follow this guide to send click events in vue 3: 
https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/events/vue/

When calling `window.aa("setUserToken", "test-user-123")` to set user token, I get the error:

`TypeError: window.aa is not a function`

How to configure this using vue 3 ?

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

- create a new vue project
- follow the steps in https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/events/vue/


### Live reproduction

h

### 💭 Expected behavior

User token should be set.
